facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's annual sector report for FY 2023/24 says it was compiled largely from the ministry's own Health Management Information System, running on District Health Information Software version 2.37, and sources its tables to 'MoH DHIS2'.
facts.system: MoH Health Management Information System (HMIS) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health reports that 6,546 health facilities were coded in DHIS2 in FY 2023/24 (52.4% government, 14.8% private not-for-profit, 32.8% private) and publishes DHIS2 figures for that year by level from national and regional referral hospitals through general hospitals and HC IVs to HC IIIs and HC IIs and clinics, for example 672,747 deliveries at HC IIIs and 127,371 at HC IIs and clinics; it notes many private facilities do not report through DHIS2.
facts.system: MoH Health Management Information System (HMIS) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health states that in FY 2023/24 decentralising data entry to facilities continued, with daily checks of data entered in DHIS2 alerting district biostatisticians to follow up on reporting; it gives no count of facilities entering their own data, and reports a monthly stock-status (HMIS 105-6) reporting rate of 87% in June 2024.
facts.system: MoH Health Management Information System (HMIS) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health reports that a DHIS2 downtime affected reporting in November 2023 and January 2024, when the monthly stock-status reporting rate fell to 73% and 77% against 80% to 87% in other months of FY 2023/24.
facts.system: MoH Health Management Information System (HMIS) on DHIS2
